candidates.title: Three Salvadoran Soldiers Die in Haiti Explosives Accident
candidates.originator: El Salvador's Armed Forces, via The Tico Times
candidates.why_new: Independently confirms (with a timestamp, not just an unverified rumor) that a third Salvadoran soldier died of injuries from the 20.11 explosives-handling accident, raising the toll from the two deaths already staged on 22.11 (which flagged a third death as unconfirmed, citing riotimesonline). Article states: two died at the scene, a third died later in a Dominican Republic hospital, a fourth was wounded but is out of danger. Directly updates Cadre 509's casualty-count cell; also notes the deployment causing the deaths operates separately from the Gang Suppression Force (the four missing Salvadoran airmen from 18.10 'remain missing' and belonged to the GSF), a command-structure distinction relevant to Cadre 7's command-clarity cell.
